description: GauGau RePatch 0.1.11: privacy controls and favorites transfer, GMS-free startup, tracker suppression, and inert Play Billing initialization.

apps.app_name: マンガがうがう～異世界漫画・悪役令嬢まんがが読める～

patches.name: GauGau privacy controls and favorites transfer
patches.description: Adds privacy controls and favorites transfer, disables tracker startup and Play Billing, and supports devices without Google services.

release_notes:
## Changes

- Fix GMS-free startup paths that depended on PairIP-populated strings and reflected lifecycle methods.
- Suppress Firebase, AppsFlyer, and Piano Analytics startup and event collection.
- Keep manga browsing available without Play Store services.
- Preserve the app-local ID and favorites import/export settings.

## Limitation

Play Billing is disabled in this build, so in-app purchases are unavailable.
